privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At Dar Al Khayma, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your information when you use our website, book our properties, or interact with our services, including our WhatsApp bot.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
items: Personal Information: When you make a reservation, contact us, or use our services
Property Preferences: Information about your accommodation preferences and travel patterns
Communication Records: Records of your communications with us through various channels
Website Usage Data: Information about how you use our website
Device Information: Technical information about your device and browser

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
items: Provide Services: To process bookings and deliver accommodation services
Customer Support: To respond to inquiries and provide customer service
Communication: To send booking confirmations and service updates
Service Improvement: To analyze usage patterns and improve our services
Marketing: With your consent, to send promotional offers
Legal Compliance: To comply with applicable laws and regulations

whatsappBot.title: WhatsApp Bot Integration
items: Automated Responses: Our WhatsApp bot provides automated responses to common inquiries
Booking Assistance: The bot helps facilitate the booking process
Message Storage: Conversations are stored to improve service quality
Opt-Out: You can stop receiving WhatsApp messages at any time
Human Oversight: Human staff review important conversations

dataSharing.title: Information Sharing
items: Service Providers: We share information with trusted third-party service providers
Property Partners: Information is shared with property owners for your stay
Legal Requirements: We may disclose information when required by law
Business Transfers: Information may be transferred in business transactions
Consent: We share information with your explicit consent

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
items: Encryption: We use industry-standard encryption to protect your information
Access Controls: Access is restricted to authorized personnel only
Regular Audits: We regularly review our security practices
Secure Storage: Data is stored on secure servers with appropriate safeguards
Incident Response: We have procedures for security incidents

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
items: Booking Records: Retained for accounting and legal purposes (typically 7 years)
Communication Records: Kept for customer service purposes (up to 3 years)
Marketing Preferences: Kept until you change them or close your account
Website Analytics: Anonymous usage data retained for up to 2 years
Legal Requirements: Some information retained longer if required by law

yourRights.title: Your Rights
items: Access: Request access to your personal information
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate information
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal information
Portability: Receive your information in a portable format
Objection: Object to certain types of processing
Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent for processing activities

internationalTransfers.title: International Transfers
items: Global Services: Information may be transferred internationally
Adequate Protection: Transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards
Third-Party Services: Service providers maintain adequate protection standards
Legal Compliance: All transfers comply with data protection laws

contact.title: Contact Us About Privacy
contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.responseTimeText: We will respond to your privacy inquiries within 30 days.

facebookIntegration.title: WhatsApp & Facebook Integration
facebookIntegration.description: Our WhatsApp bot service is powered by Meta (Facebook) technologies. By using our WhatsApp service, you acknowledge that your messages may be processed according to WhatsApp's and Meta's privacy policies in addition to our own.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by:
methods: Posting the updated policy on our website
Sending an email notification to registered users
Displaying a notice on our website or app
policyUpdates.continued: Your continued use of our services after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
